# Appendices {.unnumbered}

<!-- This lists the appendices at the beginning of the appendix pseudo-chapter, it doesn't define them. Use the right reference label (e.g. appendixexample1): -->
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textbf{\Alph*}]
    \item \hyperref[appendixexample1]{Example appendix 1}
    \item \hyperref[appendixexample2]{Example appendix 2}
\end{enumerate}

\clearpage
\begingroup
\setlength{\parindent}{0pt} 
\setstretch{1.25}

<!-- % Force a fresh anchor namespace for appendices -->
<!-- The appendices are alpha-enumerated -->
\setcounter{section}{0}
\setcounter{subsection}{0}
\renewcommand{\thesection}{\Alph{section}}
\renewcommand{\theHsection}{A\arabic{section}}
\renewcommand{\theHsubsection}{A\arabic{subsection}}

\counterwithin{table}{section}
\renewcommand{\thetable}{\thesection.\arabic{table}}

<!-- \let\origthesection\thesection -->

<!-- Page headers are blank by default for includepdf, but you can do this (check it's pretty)...
pagecommand={\markboth{Appendix \thesection. Example appendix}{}}, -->

<!-- HERE is where the appendices are defined... -->
<!-- ...you can include a pdf: -->
\includepdf[pages=-,
    pagecommand={\markboth{Appendix \thesection. Example appendix 1}{}},
    addtotoc={1,section,1,{Example appendix 1},
    appendixexample1}
    ]{front/EdUniCrest.pdf}

<!-- ...or a markdown file: -->
\appendixsection{Example appendix 2}{appendixexample1}
{{< include A001-text.qmd >}}

<!-- End of alpha enumeration -->
<!-- \let\thesection\origthesection -->

\endgroup
